title: Grateful Dead Live at William and Mary College Hall on 1973-09-11
lineage: MSR> one cassette gen> DAT> CDR> shn

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a high‑energy ’73 show highlighted by a soaring Weather Report Suite, smoking Dark Star → Morning Dew and jazzy horns.
ai_review.review: The recording is an excellent SBD source with crystal‑clear mix and only occasional tiny pops. Musically the concert shines – Weather Report Suite (Prelude → Part 1 → Let It Grow), a smoking Dark Star that bursts into a thunderous Phil Lesh solo, a soaring Morning Dew, plus tight China > Rider, Playing in the Band and vibrant horn work make this one of ’73’s standout dates.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews, most 4‑5 stars, uniformly praising performance and sound quality; only a handful of low scores with isolated criticisms.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean mix with superb clarity; minor pops/cracks noted but not disruptive. Horns sometimes a bit forward in the mix on Weather Report Suite.

standout_songs: Weather Report Suite (Prelude > Part 1 > Let It Grow)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions, especially the Weather Report Suite into Let It Grow; horns add a jazzy edge without breaking momentum. The second set builds nicely from high‑energy jams to an emotional Dew.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for passionate vocals, creative wah‑filled solos and overall tight guitar work throughout the night.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for a booming, ‘bomb’ bass solo in Dark Star and consistently powerful playing.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s keyboards noted as solid; no major criticism or specific praise beyond standard accompaniment.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s drumming described as stellar, fast shuffle and driving the jam sections.
